steps.title: New employee
steps.description: HR adds a new hire to ThunderOne. The system immediately knows what resources the person needs and starts preparing everything ahead of time, so they are ready to work from day one.
calloutItems: Creates the person's profile and role
Defines the access rights they need
Prepares devices and software
Creates onboarding tasks automatically

steps.title: Self-Onboard
steps.description: May self-onboards ahead of time — filling in her details, reading policies, and doing what she can herself. The system prepares everything else before her real start date.
calloutItems: Correct data and access from day one
Devices and software ready to use
Meets the team and culture in advance
A smooth, confident first-day experience

steps.title: Ready for Day One
steps.description: Everything is prepared in advance — devices, access rights, and the information she needs are ready from day one. May starts work smoothly.
calloutItems: Sources and hands over the right devices
Installs and configures them ready to use
Grants access rights by role
Sets up the work environment
Notifies and tracks readiness status

steps.title: An issue before a key meeting
steps.description: Right before presenting a proposal to a client, May finds she can't connect to Wi-Fi and her work is at risk. She taps Report an issue in just a few clicks. ThunderOne immediately knows what happened, to whom, and what matters for the work.
calloutItems: Auto-detects the device, location, and network
Checks usage history and key appointments
Prioritises urgency automatically
Routes the case to the Thunder Care team instantly

steps.title: Thunder Care has you covered
steps.description: The Thunder Care team takes full ownership. We already know the person, the device, and the context of the issue, so we can fix it fast and on point. Our goal is to get you back to work as quickly as possible.
calloutItems: The team receives and analyses the issue quickly
Remote support, a fix, or a replacement device
Tracks the SLA until the case is closed
Keeps you updated on progress the whole time

steps.title: Business Uptime
steps.description: Leaders see how ready the whole organisation is — people, technology, and support systems. Thunder Care keeps the business running every day.
calloutItems: Combines readiness signals for people, devices, and support
Compares against per-area targets
Flags risks that need special attention
Estimates business impact from real data
